english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone stays in a place or situation instead of leaving.

exampleSentences.english: You don't have to leave so soon; linger for a cup of tea first.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔使咁快走，留低飲杯茶先啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 zau2 lau4 dai1 jam2 bui1 caa4 sin1 laa1

english.note: Use this when someone remains behind instead of leaving, rather than specifically describing where they live or lodge.

exampleSentences.english: You go ahead; I’ll stay behind to finish up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你哋走先啦，我留低執手尾。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 dei6 zau2 sin1 laa1 ngo5 lau4 dai1 zap1 sau2 mei5

english.note: Use this when a person or thing stays behind in a place instead of leaving, especially after others have gone.

exampleSentences.english: You all go ahead; I’ll remain behind to look after the shop.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你哋走先啦，我留低睇舖。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 dei6 zau2 sin1 laa1 ngo5 lau4 dai1 tai2 pou3
